_readme: YOUR HOLDINGS. Empty on purpose - nothing here is invented.
The symbols below in _watchlist are the ones from your TradingView Portfolio
list, already checked against Yahoo. They are NOT holdings: a watchlist says
what you are watching, not what you own, how much of it, or what you paid.
Until quantity, buy_date and buy_price come from you, no portfolio figure can
be computed, and the dashboard will say so rather than show a number.
SYMBOL MAPPING - TradingView writes these differently from Yahoo:
TradingView   ->  Yahoo        what it is
AMD           ->  AMD          US stock
MP            ->  MP           US stock
LITE          ->  LITE         US stock
CHZUSDT       ->  CHZ-USD      crypto: USDT pairs become -USD
INJUSDT       ->  INJ-USD      crypto
XAUUSD        ->  GC=F         gold. Yahoo has no spot gold feed, so this is
the futures price, normally a few dollars
above spot. Use GLD if you hold the ETF.
BIST:THYAO    ->  THYAO.IS     Borsa Istanbul, if you add Turkish shares
TO ADD A HOLDING, copy this shape into the positions list:
"name": "AMD",
"symbol": "AMD",
"quantity": 0,
"buy_price": 0,
"where": "Midas"
buy_price is what you paid PER SHARE OR COIN, in that market's own currency:
dollars for AMD and CHZ-USD, lira for anything ending .IS. Mixed currencies are
converted at the live USD/TRY rate before being added up.
reporting_currency is "USD" or "TRY" - it changes how totals are displayed,
never what you own.
